outline:
本課程旨在發展學生獨立規劃及從事研究的能力，學生可在指導老師的指導下，依個別的需求選擇研究的方向，訂定題目，並獨立完成研究計畫，撰寫報告。
專題研究範圍含：
實驗研究
量調查研究或質調查研究
個案研究
回溯研究
文化比較研究
理論闡述研究
schedule:
Weeks 1-8: Continue review of primary and secondary material; hand in one written page per week.

Weeks 9-14: Reorganize and polish thesis.

Weeks 15-18: Prepare for the oral exam; weekly coaching sessions.
assessment: 55% of the grade for the completed thesis; 15% each for performance in the oral exam, cooperation/discussions with the teacher, and overall work discipline.
